svg.title: GPU Deck system overview
svg.desc: Apps and AI gateways call the GPU Deck control plane's serving API with an API key, and admins use the web UI, desktop app, CLI or Terraform. The control plane runs on one CPU server with Docker Compose or Helm: serving API, agent hub, agent tunnels, jobs and workers, web UI, admin API, PostgreSQL and Redis, and needs no GPU. GPU machines run only the node agent and the engines on localhost; the agent dials out to the control plane over mutual TLS, so a GPU machine opens no inbound port by default.
